/api/analytics/conversion.reason: Proven end-to-end by tests/regression/test-conversion.mjs, not by a Playwright spec. That gate drives a real browser through the landing and sign-up surfaces and asserts each instrumented element actually fires its event, which is the failure this route has: a missing conversion event breaks no page and fails no other test, it only makes the funnel look like nobody clicked. It runs in CI (quality.yml, after the a11y gate). A Playwright spec that POSTed the endpoint directly would assert less, since the endpoint working is not the part that goes wrong.
